title: A restaurant-scoped call with no Authorization header is a 401 ErrorMessage

source.note: The page documents 401 as 'The authentication token you submitted is not a recognized Toast API authentication token' and is silent on a request that submits no token at all; the unit answers the same 401 for both, which is this project's judgment (toast/auth.py). The ErrorMessage shape is the page's example; the message wording is not documented and is asserted as any string.
